name: Assume Quirk
description: Familiar viewers get no bonus to see through your disguise.

name: Group Fake-Out
description: Feint against multiple foes simultaneously

name: Never Outnumbered
description: Demoralize multiple foes simultaneously.

name: Second Impression
description: Make Bluff check to reestablish blown disguise.

name: Social Recovery
description: Make a Bluff check to replace a failed Diplomacy check.

name: Timely Misdirection
description: Successful feint allows you to avoid Attacks of Opportunity

name: Clever Improviser
description: Ignore penalty for Disable Device and Open Lock checks made without tools.
prerequisites: Disable Device 5 ranks, Open Lock 5 ranks

name: Conceal Spellcasting
description: Conceal your spellcasting from onlookers.
prerequisites: Concentration 1 ranks, Sleight of Hand 5 ranks, Spellcraft 1 rank

name: Easy Escape
description: Gain Bonus on check to escape grapple or pin.
prerequisites: Medium or smaller size (not verified), Escape Artist 8 ranks

name: False Theurgy
description: Your spell appears to be another spell of the same level.
prerequisites: Bluff or Sleight of Hand 8 ranks, Spellcraft 8 rank

name: Healing Hands
description: Heal 1d6 damage when you stabilize a dying character.

name: Hidden Blade
description: Draw hidden weapon as move action; treat foe as flat-footed.
prerequisites: Sleight of Hand 5 ranks, Quick Draw

name: Mosquito's Bite
description: Flat-footed target does not notice damage you deal with a light weapon.

name: Opening Tap
description: Open a lock as a swift action.

name: Quick Escape
description: Escape from grapple or restraints more quickly than normal.

name: Shrouded Dance
description: Use move action to gain concealment for 1 round.

name: Sudden Draw
description: Draw hidden weapon as part of Attack of Opportunity.
prerequisites: Sleight of Hand 8 ranks, Quick Draw

name: Whip Climber
description: Use a whip as a grappling hook.
prerequisites: Use Rope 5 ranks, proficiency with whip

name: Clarity of Vision
description: Notice invisible enemies for 1 round.

name: Collector of Stories
description: Gain +5 bonus on Knowledge checks to identify monsters.

name: Listen to This
description: Perfectly repeat what you've recently heard.

name: Magical Appraisal
description: Determine properties of magic items.
prerequisites: Appraise 5 ranks, Knowledge (arcana) 5 ranks, Spellcraft 12 ranks

name: Point it Out
description: Grant ally a free Spot check to see something you've spotted.

name: Spot the Weak Point
description: Make your next attack a touch attack.

name: Swift Concentration
description: Maintain concentration on a spell as a swift action.

name: Acrobatic Backstab
description: Move through foe's space to render it flat-footed.

name: Back on Your Feet
description: React immediately to stand up from prone.

name: Corner Perch
description: Perch in chimney or corner to leave hands free.

name: Dismount Attack
description: Make a fast dismount from moving mount to charge a foe.

name: Escape Attack
description: Make an attack the same round you escape a grapple.

name: Extreme Leap
description: Horizontal jump of at least 10 feet allows 10 extra feet of movement that round.

name: Leaping Climber
description: Add jump distance to start of climb.

name: Nimble Charge
description: Run or charge across difficult surface without Balance check.

name: Nimble Stand
description: Stand from prone safely.

name: Quick Swimmer
description: Swim 10 additional feet with successful check.

name: Slipping Past
description: Move into tight space without penalties.

name: Speedy Ascent
description: Climb 10 additional feet with successful check.

name: Tumbling Crawl
description: Crawl 5 feet without provoking Attacks of Opportunity.

name: Twisted Charge
description: Make 1 direction change during a charge.

name: Up the Hill
description: Move up slope or stairs at normal speed.

name: Walk the Walls
description: Run straight up wall for 1 round.

name: Wall Jumper
description: Leap from wall as if making a running jump.
